sources.title: Thenlper: GTE-Large - Free AI on Rewind.ai
sources.snippet: The gte-large embedding model converts English sentences, paragraphs and moderate-length documents into a 1024-dimensional dense vector space, delivering high-quality semantic embeddings optimized for information retrieval, semantic textual similarity, reranking and clustering tasks.

sources.title: Models | OpenCode
sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
